Install and configure Rugix Ctrl.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name       | Default | Description                                                                     |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `use_musl` | `true`  | Choose statically linked musl binaries instead of GNU libc binaries.            |
| `version`  | `"v1"`  | Binary source: container, a release series such as v1, or an exact release tag. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `700000`     |
| Dependencies | `pkg-update` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

The container source uses the binaries bundled with Bakery. A release series
resolves the newest matching published release, including prereleases; an exact
tag downloads that release. Pin an exact tag when a build must keep the same
Rugix Ctrl version.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rugix-ctrl"]

[parameters."core/rugix-ctrl"]
version = "container"
```
